thread:
Leah: Heads-up — Nimbus renewal just escalated. They want a custom SLA: 99th pct latency <= 150ms for embeddings across bursty traffic. Renewal in 6 weeks. Sales asked if we can turn this into a committed SLA now. Thoughts on cost/risk vs signal for roadmap? :warning:
Miguel: They called this morning. Renewal contingent on perceived reliability. They're a large account (~$500k ARR). Offer needs to show we're taking latency risk seriously. Can we scope a short-term commitment? :grimacing:
Anna: Quick RICE take: Reach = 1 acct (but big), Impact = high on $ retention, Confidence = medium (depends on engineering), Effort = large. Score leans toward 'do if low engineering unknowns'.
Ken: Engineering reality check — to guarantee 150ms p99 for embeddings at their 1k qps bursts we'd need Dedicated capacity + aggressive KV caching + quantization testing. Rough effort: 3-4 sprints + infra cost delta ~ $25k/month.
Priya: Renewal probability if we accept a conditional SLA? Sales says +30% chance. If that's true ROI might work. Need exact numbers on uplift vs cost.
Anna: Two-pronged proposal: 1) Offer a canary SLA for 90 days with a capped financial exposure (eg credits up to $50k) and auto-fallback policy; 2) Parallel 'Optimize' engagement (free) to tune batching/caching for their patterns. This limits risk and gives runway.
Miguel: Customer would accept a pilot if phrased as 'limited commitment' rather than permanent SLA. They'll still push for earlier full SLA though.
Ken: Implementation notes:
```
- Dedicated pool: pin 8xA100
- Autoscale buffer: +20% headroom
- KV prefix caching + per-route cache TTL
- Fallback: route to model variant with relaxed latency
```
Will need SRE signoff on incident playbook and rollback triggers.
Leah: Decision needed by EOD Friday for sales to include in terms. Can PM/Eng/Sales agree on pilot terms? @Ken @Priya @Miguel
Priya: I'll draft customer email with pilot wording and credit cap. Also ask CS to prepare monitoring dashboard access and alerting.
Ken: I'll estimate infra delta and run a quick perf sim by Thursday; if perf sim shows >80% chance to meet p99 under pilot config I'll signal thumbs-up.
Anna: If perf sim looks marginal we do phased SLA: start with SLO-backed trial (no credits) and move to financial SLA only after 3 months of steady metrics.
Miguel: Sounds good. I'll update customer and flag urgency. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: New task created: #task-4321 'Nimbus SLA pilot: perf sim + pilot contract' assigned to Ken, Priya, Miguel — due 2026-04-09.
